        $host_mismatch = "hostname" wide ascii

arguments.summary: Re-execution of containment actions from multiple prior incidents (INC-2026-0555, INC-2026-0587, INC-2026-0601, INC-2026-0598) was initiated as a proactive hardening measure following new threat intelligence. However, the replay failed during the Monitor and Admin phases due to tool access restrictions. The Analyze phase confirmed ongoing activity associated with IOCs from prior incidents, including IP 185.220.101.42 and file hash 7f0a1e9f9b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e. Full containment could not be re-established due to insufficient tool permissions in non-respond phases.
